description:
This is an exceptionally rare and beautiful antique English fine bone china silent butler (table crumb catcher), manufactured by the world-renowned Mintons factory This lot is a pair of antique English fine bone china silent butler pans (table crumb catchers) manufactured by the legendary Mintons factory in England.
Both pieces showcase the highly desirable Pattern H1619, featuring a wide, heavily encrusted acid-etched gold scrollwork border, detailed geometric 22K gilt.  two distinct retail commissions from competing Gilded Age luxury purveyors in New York City:
• Davis Collamore Commission (With Lid): Features the custom gold-stamped "Davis Collamore & Co. Ltd. / Fifth Ave & 37th St New York" importer mark. Includes its matching custom-fit, dome-lidded companion with a solid gold-gilt finial. Dates precisely between 1890 and 1911.
• Tiffany & Co. Commission (No Lid): Features the custom gold-stamped "Tiffany & Co. New York" retailer mark on the base. This piece is presented as the open pan only (no lid included). Dates between 1873 and 1912.

description:
A vintage Vibration Records single by Sylvia, pairing the sultry R&B classic "Pillow Talk" with the funky "My Thing." Released in 1973 on the light blue Vibration label, a division of All Platinum Record Co., this 45 is a great addition to collections of Sylvia, early 1970s soul, R&B, and funk records, as well as All Platinum and Sugar Hill history.
Side A: "Pillow Talk" (3:41), written by Sylvia Robinson and Michael Burton, produced by Sylvia Robinson and Michael Burton
Side B: "My Thing" (2:45), written by S. Robinson, produced by Sylvia
Artist: Sylvia
Label: Vibration Records, Inc., a division of All Platinum Record Co.
Format: 7-inch, 45 RPM single
Catalog number: VI-521 (VI-521A on Side A, VI-521B on Side B)
The record shows visible reflections from the glossy vinyl, and the labels appear clean with minimal age-related wear. Offered as pictured.

description:
This is an exquisite pair of antique English bone china teacups and matching saucers manufactured by the historic Mintons factory and commissioned exclusively for Tiffany & Co., New York.
This premium set dates between 1873 and 1912, capturing the peak luxury of the Gilded Age.
Both sets feature Pattern H1649, a high-end design distinguished by its heavy, encrusted gold scrollwork borders, beautifully scalloped rims, and a radiant gilded band running along the inner cup rims.
Tea cups bears the stamped gold Mintons crowned globe hallmark alongside the custom "Tiffany & Co. New York / Made in England" retailer mark.
Saucers bear stamped gold Mintons crowned hallmark alongside "Davis Collamore & Co. / FIFTH AVE & 37TH ST/ NEW YORK."
